releases.title: WaterCat 1.0: a whole lot of new cat

items.text: Colour themes: Lavender Dream, Cherry Blossom, Sunflower Field, Matcha & Rose, Autumn Harvest, Cozy Maple, Plum & Olive, Autumn Twilight and more (Settings → Colours).
Pick your drink: water, kombucha, tea, coffee or boba, each with its own little picture and counter word, like BOOCHES for kombucha. Or type your own word.
Reach your daily goal and the cat throws a party: party hat, disco ball, dancing lights and a little tune. The hat stays on until midnight.

Rewards: keep your streak going to unlock heart glasses, a flower crown, Rainbow and Galaxy fur, a gold crown and a little kitten who sits beside your cat. Every 7-day streak brings a fish treat to feed her, and sometimes she kneads when you pet her a lot.

Accessories (Customize → 🎀 Accessories): bow, glasses, sunglasses, crown, scarf, bandana, bell collar and a name-tag collar, each in your colours, for each cat. Plus seasonal outfits: Santa hat, bunny ears, witch hat and a heart pin.

Play with the cat! Right-click → Play: a ball to flick, a fish on a stick, a yarn ball or a toy mouse. She chases, pounces and purrs, for up to 3 minutes. Everything else stays clickable. Stop with the ⏹ button (drag it where you like), Esc or right-click → Stop playing; she goes back to her spot.
Streaks: days in a row you reached your goal (in the menu), with a little celebration at 3, 7, 14, 30, 60 and 100 days.
Stats: your last 7 and 30 days as a bar chart, plus streaks, averages and totals.
Pause reminders for an hour or until tomorrow, cute new reminder lines (yours still comes most often), at most one full meow an hour, and quieter reminders while you play fullscreen.
The cat's mood follows your day: ears down when you're far behind, extra tail wags when you're on track.
The cat's eyes follow your mouse, and she has new little moves: yawning, grooming, looking around and curling her tail.
Walk along the taskbar (right-click menu or Settings): now and then she strolls a little way and sits again.
Every drink you log is also a pet: a happy squint, hearts and a little chirp (Settings → Sound).
My colours: make your own colour theme.
Report a problem or suggest an idea, right from Settings or the right-click menu.
A brand-new right-click menu in your theme's colours. It closes when you click anywhere else.
A Settings button on the cat when you hover over her.
Settings got a tidy new look, a quick-action toolbar and little ? tips.
This What's new window.
Fixed: typing a cat's name sometimes did nothing.
After an update the cat tells you once that she got updated.
A desktop cat who reminds you to drink water and counts your cups.
Several cats, each with their own name, look, description and sleeping spot.
Daily alarms with your own message.
Automatic updates.
